description: manifest rules: new items with clients none (KL201), client assets without clients mod (KL202), icons in a side server mod (KL203), a missing entryAssembly in a built folder (KL205), talent trees without clients mod (KL207), a manifest Kiln.Host refuses (KL209), a non-SPDX licence (KL602)

diagnostics.message: "../gem.png": a path relative to assets/ (subfolders allowed; no absolute path, no '..')

this mod adds a new item (and maybe more) but says no "clients" (side "server" means "none"): vanilla clients cannot show it ("[Invalid Item Stack]"); declare "clients": "kiln" (the server sends the definitions to Kiln clients and refuses vanilla ones) or "mod" (players install the mod)
this mod ships a PNG item icon but says no "clients" (side "server" means "none"): players without the mod never see them; declare "clients": "mod" so the server's modpack delivers it
a PNG item icon is drawn by clients, but side "server" mods do not load on a joined client (only when a player hosts); use side "both"

this mod has a talent tree but says no "clients" (side "server" means "none"): players without the mod can only use it through the /talents chat command; to draw its screen on their game, declare "clients": "mod" and side "both" (vanilla clients are then refused, unless the server's modSync is off)
"MIT License" is not an SPDX licence expression; did you mean "MIT"?
Missing.dll is not in the mod folder (Kiln.Host fails to load the mod)
Kiln.Host refuses this manifest: kiln.mod.json: 'other' is in both loadBefore and loadAfter
